mentions.description: An array programming language (named Jet in the code examples) currently implementing its tokens → three-address code → bytecode translation pipeline, with plans to implement builtins and library functions next. Core primitives like grade/argsort (asc) bootstrap many other functions, such as implementing binary search via double-grade idiom.
